title: Keep the active source and prepared probe distinct
statement: Spin-independent two-orbital hopping makes all THREE triplets dark while the singly occupied singlet couples to BOTH doublons with the SAME sqrt(2)G_E. Noncommuting source dynamics can be arbitrarily fast WITHIN that finite-orbital theorem, without qualifying physical orbital/lead closure. Known bare hopping above ||B_E|| gives a positive gap; constant electrostatic potential cancels by orbital orthogonality, while curvature and detector-induced unwanted hopping remain. A separately PREPARED Coulomb probe with chi n_L n_p and Ramsey/two counted ports has ideal charge port probabilities1,.5,0 for n_L=0,1,2. Repetition requires a complete QND charge INSTRUMENT, including correlated trials and bounded imperfections, rather than classical charge fidelity alone.

requires: Two electrons/two spin-degenerate orbitals with common Hermitian hopping G_E, gI<=G_E<=hI, spin-independent interactions and qualified differential detuning; arbitrary source/reference/history correlations within the finite-orbital model.
Separately prepared orbital probes, complete charge instruments, real pair access/loading/return/routing, calibrated relative controls/reservoirs and explicit source-domain conditions.
